title: Oracle C2M Environment Migration & Code Promotion (Dev → QA → Prod)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Promote C2M config and code cleanly across environments
problem: C2M configuration and extensions have to move from Dev → QA → Prod without drift or manual mistakes. This solution defines the migration and code-promotion method: OUAF configuration migration (bundles / Configuration Migration Assistant), code and web-service promotion, and environment-comparison — so what you tested is exactly what goes live, pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M promotion model: OUAF config migration (bundles/CMA), code/IWS promotion, and environment comparison.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (source+target environments, migration tooling, access, change control).
Implementation Guide — exact steps to export/import OUAF config bundles, promote code and web services, compare environments, and validate parity, across Dev→QA→Prod with gates.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (config migrated, parity confirmed, no drift) plus Best Practices for repeatable promotion.
short: Define the C2M migration and code-promotion method — OUAF config migration, code/IWS promotion, environment comparison — so what you tested is what goes live, Dev→QA→Prod, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
